about.title: Acerca de Global City Review
about.p1: Global City Review es un sitio internacional de comentario para investigadores de política urbana, equipos del sector público, consultoras, editores de medios y observadores de ciudades con horizonte largo. Cubrimos gobernanza urbana, infraestructura, economía regional, finanzas públicas, vivienda y movimientos de población.
about.p2: El sitio es mantenido por el equipo editorial de Global Urban Policy Institute. Publicamos editoriales, análisis urbanos, perspectivas regionales, perspectivas expertas y comentarios tipo informe. Cada pieza debe identificar evidencia, fuentes públicas, límites de inferencia e incertidumbres.

principles.title: Principios editoriales
principles.h1: Los argumentos pueden ser claros, la evidencia debe ser rastreable
principles.p1: Valoramos el juicio en el comentario urbano, pero no presentamos la especulación como hecho. Las afirmaciones sobre política, inversión, población, transporte, servicios públicos o finanzas municipales deben apoyarse siempre que sea posible en documentos oficiales, estadísticas originales, material académico o reportajes creíbles.
principles.p2: No fabricamos entrevistas, comentarios de conferencias, documentos internos ni datos no publicados. Cuando un artículo usa análisis editorial, debe distinguir hechos, inferencias y comentario.
principles.h3: Primero los asuntos de largo plazo
principles.p3: Priorizamos temas que moldean la capacidad urbana de largo plazo: resiliencia fiscal, vivienda asequible, gobernanza de infraestructura, coordinación regional, geografía industrial, confianza pública y adaptación climática.
principles.p4: Los lectores pueden contactar a la mesa editorial mediante el email del pie de página si encuentran un error de hechos, una fuente rota o un límite poco claro entre hecho y opinión.

privacy.title: Política de privacidad
privacy.p1: Global City Review sigue un enfoque de minimización de datos. Al visitar el sitio, servidores, proveedores de alojamiento o servicios de seguridad pueden registrar dirección IP, tipo de navegador, hora de acceso, ruta solicitada, registros de error e información básica del dispositivo.
privacy.p2: El sitio actualmente no ofrece cuentas de lector ni herramientas de perfilado, y no recopila emails mediante formularios.
privacy.p3: Los mensajes de lectores pueden incluir sugerencias, correcciones, fuentes, consultas de licencia o cooperación. Usamos esta información solo para verificación editorial, respuesta, retención de cumplimiento y auditoría de seguridad.
privacy.p4: Para consultar, corregir o eliminar registros de email relacionados contigo, contacta

terms.title: Términos de uso
terms.p1: El contenido del sitio sirve para discutir política urbana, desarrollo regional y asuntos públicos. Los análisis y juicios se basan en materiales públicos e interpretación editorial.
terms.p2: Los lectores pueden citar títulos, breves extractos y enlaces dentro de límites razonables conservando la atribución. La republicación completa, el raspado sistemático o la reutilización engañosa requiere permiso escrito previo.
terms.p3: Los enlaces externos identifican fuentes públicas o materiales de referencia. Global City Review no controla su contenido, disponibilidad o exactitud posterior.
terms.p4: Para licencias, correcciones, fuentes adicionales o cooperación, contacta

cookie.title: Política de cookies
cookie.p1: Global City Review actualmente no usa cookies de seguimiento publicitario, etiquetas de marketing entre sitios ni perfilado de lectores por cookies.
cookie.p2: El alojamiento, distribución de contenido, seguridad o funcionamiento del framework puede usar cookies necesarias para rutas de idioma, seguridad de sesión, balanceo de carga, control de caché y detección de solicitudes anómalas.
cookie.p3: Si más adelante añadimos analítica, cuentas u otros servicios que requieran cookies adicionales, actualizaremos esta página antes de activarlos.
cookie.p4: Los lectores pueden eliminar o limitar cookies desde el navegador. Limitar cookies necesarias puede afectar redirecciones de idioma, seguridad o carga de páginas.

sections.heading: Qué cubrimos
body: GlobalCityReview is a city policy, infrastructure and urban affairs news service operated by GlobalCityReview. It covers city analysis, regional outlook, expert perspectives, with emphasis on verifiable facts, clear context, and practical relevance for its readers.
The site is written for professionals, researchers, public-affairs readers, and interested general audiences who need concise orientation without exaggerated certainty.

sections.heading: Cómo usar nuestro trabajo
body: Articles may summarize public documents, official notices, company announcements, research material, event information, and other accessible sources. We distinguish proposals, approvals, launches, results, and later updates so early-stage plans are not described as completed outcomes.

Readers should use the content for news reading, research, and general situational awareness. Before relying on any item for a decision, consult original documents, current dates, applicable jurisdictions, and qualified professionals.

sections.heading: Contacto y operador
body: For corrections, source questions, privacy requests, or editorial contact, email: {email}
Mailing address: {address}

sections.heading: Independencia y fuentes
body: GlobalCityReview is edited to preserve independence from advertisers, sponsors, sources, and political or commercial interests. Coverage choices are based on relevance, evidence, public interest, and fit with the site’s stated beats.

We prefer primary sources, named organizations, official records, public filings, research reports, and clearly attributable statements. Unverified rumors or second-hand claims are not presented as settled fact.

sections.heading: Revisión, actualizaciones y correcciones
body: Editors check names, dates, figures, locations, document status, and context before publication when practical. If credible new information changes a story, we may update the article, add a correction note, or revise wording to reflect the available record.
Readers can send correction requests to {email}. We review requests against source material and may receive written notices at {address}.

sections.heading: Automatización y límites
body: Editorial teams may use translation, research, summarization, formatting, or quality-control tools, including automated assistance. Human editors remain responsible for publication decisions and for ensuring tools do not invent sources, quotes, or certainty.

Content is for information only and is not legal, investment, tax, medical, engineering, procurement, or policy-compliance advice. We use cautious language where outcomes depend on regulation, markets, litigation, technical review, or future implementation.

sections.heading: Información que recopilamos
body: When readers visit GlobalCityReview, technical systems may collect server logs, page paths, access times, device and browser type, broad location, referring pages, IP address, cookie identifiers, and error information.

When you contact us, we process the name, email address, organization, message content, attachments, and other details you choose to provide. Search queries and forms should not include sensitive personal information.

sections.heading: Cómo se usa la información
body: We use information to operate and secure the site, measure public page performance, respond to messages, process correction or privacy requests, detect abuse, and improve loading and navigation.

Hosting, analytics, security, email, translation, and content-delivery providers may process limited technical data for us. We do not sell reader personal information or add editorial contacts to unrelated marketing lists.

sections.heading: Conservación, derechos y contacto
body: We keep information only as long as reasonably needed for operations, security, legal obligations, dispute handling, and editorial accountability. Retention periods vary by data type and provider.
Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to certain processing. Requests can be sent to {email}; postal correspondence may be sent to {address}.

sections.heading: Uso permitido
body: You may read, link to, and quote short excerpts from GlobalCityReview for lawful personal, research, educational, or professional reference, provided attribution is clear and the context is not misleading.
You may not scrape at scale, republish full articles, remove attribution, bypass technical controls, interfere with the site, or use content in a way that violates rights, laws, or platform rules.

sections.heading: Sin asesoramiento profesional
body: Content is provided for general information and editorial reference. It is not legal, investment, tax, medical, engineering, procurement, or policy-compliance advice, and it should not replace reviewing original documents or consulting qualified professionals.
Facts, laws, markets, standards, policies, and project details can change after publication. We do not promise that every article is complete, current, or suitable for any particular decision.

sections.heading: Derechos, enlaces y responsabilidad
body: Unless otherwise stated, site text, design, and original editorial materials are protected by copyright and other rights. Third-party names, logos, images, documents, and links remain the property or responsibility of their respective owners.
External links are provided for context and convenience. We are not responsible for third-party sites. Questions about these terms can be sent to {email}; notices may be mailed to {address}.

sections.heading: Cookies necesarias y preferencias
body: GlobalCityReview uses essential cookies and similar technologies to make pages load, remember security choices, manage language or region preferences, and support basic site functions.

Preference cookies may remember settings such as language, display options, or selected filters. Disabling them may make the site less convenient but should not prevent access to ordinary public pages.

sections.heading: Analítica y servicios integrados
body: Analytics cookies help us understand page traffic, device categories, referrers, errors, and content performance in aggregated or limited form. These signals support editorial planning and technical maintenance.
Embedded services, such as video, maps, social sharing, fonts, analytics, or security tools, may place their own cookies or collect technical data under their own policies.

sections.heading: Gestión de cookies
body: You can control cookies through browser settings, device controls, private browsing modes, consent tools where available, or third-party opt-out mechanisms. Blocking some cookies may affect preferences, embedded media, analytics, or security checks.
For questions about cookies or related privacy choices, contact {email}. Written requests may also be sent to {address}.
